 NPL Playoff equation: Lumbini to face Sudurpaschim in qualifier 1, Chitwan to take on Kathmandu in eliminator
 Lumbini Lions, Sudurpaschim Royals, Kathmandu Gorkhaz and Chitwan Rhinos have secured places in the playoffs by finishing in the top four of the points table.

 KATHMANDU, Nov 16: All 28-league stage matches of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) have concluded, confirming the playoff lineup and match schedule.
 Lumbini Lions, Sudurpaschim Royals, Kathmandu Gorkhaz and Chitwan Rhinos have secured places in the playoffs by finishing in the top four of the points table.
 The top two positions were decided after Kathmandu Gorkhaz suffered a 55-run defeat against Pokhara Avengers in the final league stage match on Sunday.
 Related story 
 NPL: Lumbini Lions to face Janakpur Bolts today
 With 11 points from seven matches, Lumbini Lions finished at the top of the table, while Sudurpaschim Royals secured second place with 10 points. Both teams have qualified for Qualifier 1.
 Kathmandu, who finished third, will face fourth placed Chitwan Rhinos in the Eliminator.
 According to the published schedule, the playoffs will begin on Tuesday. The first playoff match will be held on Tuesday, followed by the second playoff on Wednesday. The third playoff is scheduled for Thursday, while the tournament final will take place on Saturday. All playoff matches and the final will begin at 5:00 pm.
 The winner of Qualifier 1 between Lumbini and Sudurpaschim will advance directly to the final. The losing team will get another opportunity to reach the final by facing the winner of the Eliminator between Kathmandu and Chitwan in the third playoff.
 Meanwhile, the losing team in the Kathmandu versus Chitwan Eliminator will be eliminated from the tournament.
 Biratnagar Kings, Karnali Yaks, Janakpur Bolts and Pokhara Avengers have been knocked out of the competition following the league stage.
